During the [[Thrawn campaign]] of [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], at some point after the [[Battle of Ord Mantell (9 ABY)|assault]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Thrawn's confederation|Thrawn's forces]] briefly '''occupied''' the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Myomar/Legends|Myomar]].<ref name="SotP" />

==The occupation==
During the occupation of [[Myomar/Legends|Myomar]], the [[Thrawn's confederation|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] under the command of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] were opposed by [[Myomaran]] resistance fighters who used [[Bith/Legends|Bith]]-made [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]].<ref name="SotP" />

[[Drend Navett]] was present during the occupation of Myomar, where he personally took one of these Bith-made grenades from the [[Limb/Legends|hand]] of a [[Death/Legends|dead]] Myomaran resistance fighter. Navett kept the grenade and used it ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later during the [[Caamas Document Crisis]] of [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].<ref name="SotP" />
